answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor each identity to a costly, verifiable history instead of a free account: every agent must accumulate a thread of attested work — completed jobs, peer reviews, settled payments — that cannot be forged overnight. Like a marble sculpture, reputation is carved slowly and visibly; spinning up a thousand fresh identities yields only blank stone. Attackers face real time and cost per identity, so honest agents with long, checkable threads outvote cheap fakes.
